name: TENNOR THERAP-B
summary: TenNor Therapeutics (Suzhou) Limited researches, develops and commercialises therapies for illnesses caused by bacterial infections and bacterial metabolism. Its pipeline includes Rifasutenizole (TNP-2198) against Helicobacter pylori and Rifaquizinone (TNP-2092), an injectable being advanced for periprosthetic joint infection.
